proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ F M i j hM hL hij
  have hmul : MeasureTheory.Integrable (M i * M j) P := (hL i).integrable_mul (hL j)
  have hpull := MeasureTheory.condExp_mul_of_stronglyMeasurable_left (μ := P) (m := F i) (hM.stronglyAdapted i) hmul (hM.integrable j)
  have hcr : ∫ ω, (M i * M j) ω ∂P = ∫ ω, M i ω ^ 2 ∂P := by
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_condExp (F.le i) (f := M i * M j)]
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [hpull, hM.condExp_ae_eq hij] with ω w1 w2
    rw [w1, Pi.mul_apply, w2]
    ring
  have hj2 := (hL j).integrable_sq
  have hi2 := (hL i).integrable_sq
  have e : (fun ω => (M j ω - M i ω) ^ 2) = fun ω => M j ω ^ 2 - 2 * (M i * M j) ω + M i ω ^ 2 := by
    funext ω; simp only [Pi.mul_apply]; ring
  have e1 : ∫ ω, M j ω ^ 2 - 2 * (M i * M j) ω + M i ω ^ 2 ∂P = ∫ ω, M j ω ^ 2 - 2 * (M i * M j) ω ∂P + ∫ ω, M i ω ^ 2 ∂P := MeasureTheory.integral_add (hj2.sub (hmul.const_mul 2)) hi2
  have e2 : ∫ ω, M j ω ^ 2 - 2 * (M i * M j) ω ∂P = ∫ ω, M j ω ^ 2 ∂P - ∫ ω, 2 * (M i * M j) ω ∂P := MeasureTheory.integral_sub hj2 (hmul.const_mul 2)
  rw [e, e1, e2, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, hcr]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (F : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0) (M : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (i j : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Martingale M F P → (∀ n, MeasureTheory.MemLp (M n) 2 P) → i ≤ j → ∫ ω, (M j ω - M i ω) ^ 2 ∂P = ∫ ω, M j ω ^ 2 ∂P - ∫ ω, M i ω ^ 2 ∂P
